_comment: Magical Door plan Task D4 (issue #8, spec §4/the O2 rule): the fast-travel round-trip -- menu -> street arrival (pinning the map_changed PAIR: inn->street then street->inn, in order, via the since-marker) -- AND asserts no combat_started/trigger event fires on EITHER arrival (portal travel goes through transition() ONLY; move_player/_check_trigger_radius are never called by it) -- then the return trip. Fixture starts door_awakened already banked, standing at (9,6) facing the awakened pantry_door. The whole script issues ZERO `move` QA actions (only `press interact`/`press confirm`), so a bare `assert_event_absent player_moved` for the FULL run is itself part of the O2 proof: nothing in this script's own input stream could produce one, and neither can transition().

steps._comment: move down to the 'Continue' row, confirm loads the portal_menu_start manual slot.

payload_contains.text: Cold light, gone as fast as it came. The gate district's noise rushes back in around you.

steps.name: interact

payload_contains.text: Warm air, woodsmoke, the creak of the pantry door settling shut behind you. You're back, and you didn't walk here.

steps._comment: == The O2 rule, whole-run: neither arrival ever fires a trigger/combat event, and this script never issues a single `move` action of its own -- so a player_moved event can ONLY have come from move_player, which portal travel never calls. ==
